screen.title: Announcement: Elevator repairs
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement made to students.

audio.text: Hello, residents of Oak Hall. The elevator will be closed for repairs from Monday to Wednesday next week. Please use the stairs during this time. If you need help carrying something heavy, ask at the front desk, and a staff member will help you. Thank you.

options: A new elevator in Oak Hall
An elevator that will not work for a few days
A change in the front desk hours

why.en: Main idea (paraphrase of "closed for repairs from Monday to Wednesday"). A confuses repairs with a new elevator; C and D are not mentioned.
why.tr: Ana fikir ("closed for repairs from Monday to Wednesday" ifadesinin parafrazı). A onarımı yeni asansörle karıştırıyor; C ve D hiç geçmiyor.
why.es: Idea principal (paráfrasis de "closed for repairs from Monday to Wednesday"). A confunde la reparación con un ascensor nuevo; C y D no se mencionan.

questions.stem: What should residents do if they need help with something heavy?

why.en: Detail: "ask at the front desk, and a staff member will help you". B and D are not suggested; A is never mentioned.
why.tr: Ayrıntı: "ask at the front desk, and a staff member will help you". B ve D önerilmiyor; A hiç geçmiyor.
why.es: Detalle: "ask at the front desk, and a staff member will help you". B y D no se proponen; A no se menciona.
